seo.title: About
seo.description: Learn about VoiceBridge Pro — why it was built, our mission, vision, and roadmap for the future of AAC communication technology for people of determination.

hero.description: VoiceBridge Pro was born from a simple belief: every child deserves to be heard, and every parent deserves to know what their child needs.

whyWeBuiltThis.heading: Communication is a Right, Not a Privilege
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph1: In South Asia, the Middle East, and across the world, families of people of determination face a critical gap: the AAC tools that exist are designed for Western markets, prohibitively expensive, and almost never available in Urdu or Arabic.
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph2: VoiceBridge Pro was built to change that. We started with one question: what would a communication app look like if it was designed specifically for families of people of determination across South Asia and beyond?
whyWeBuiltThis.paragraph3: The answer: bilingual, affordable, mobile-first, and deeply connected to the family unit — with real-time parent alerts at its core.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To give every non-verbal child a voice, and every parent the confidence of knowing what their child needs — regardless of geography or resources.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: A world where communication disability is no longer a barrier to expressing fundamental human needs. Technology that truly serves underrepresented communities.

familyFirst.title: Family First
familyFirst.desc: Every decision is made by asking: does this make life easier for families?

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: Great AAC tools should be available to every family, not just those with resources.

evidenceBased.title: Evidence-Based
evidenceBased.desc: Our approach is informed by speech-language pathology research and clinical best practices.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.desc: We will never monetize your child's data. This is a non-negotiable principle.

continuousImprovement.title: Continuous Improvement
continuousImprovement.desc: We ship updates regularly, driven by feedback from the families who use VoiceBridge Pro.

community.title: Community
community.desc: VoiceBridge Pro is built in partnership with families, therapists, and educators.

roadmap.heading: Where We're Headed
roadmap.description: VoiceBridge Pro is actively developed. Here's what we've built and what's coming.
